name: Interview-first: clarifying questions fire before any research
title_en: Interview-first — clarifying questions before research starts
title_zh: 访谈优先——研究开始前先提出澄清问题
summary_en: Without the no-interview prefix, the deep-research skill asks its clarifying-question batch as ONE turn and does not start researching — even under non-interactive `opencode run --auto`.
summary_zh: 未加 no-interview 前缀时，深度研究技能会在一轮内集中提出澄清问题，且不先开始检索——即便是在非交互的 `opencode run --auto` 模式下。
purpose: Shows the interview-first core feature (cheap: no MCP network calls expected).
prompt: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill, run a deep research report on CAR-T therapy safety in solid tumors.

checks.desc: the final assistant message must be (or contain) the clarifying-question batch
research must not have run yet - the interview turn comes first (skip only via the no-interview prefix)
no research queries during the interview turn
